notes.title: Final release update
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31209455/91e6bc9532625870d2c1e465e6ff47d01f94d862.jpg

Hey,

We’ve just released a massive update that brings a lot of changes to both the gameplay and visual side of the Regenesis Arcade. With it comes a lot of bug fixes and performance improvements, based on your feedback and reports.

New features include:
- 12 new weapons, making it total of 16 different ones you can use throughout the game, with distinct parameters and sets of strengths and weaknesses,
- Weapon chest and ammo drop system, giving you random weapons based on the level you are currently on and introducing the resources economy,
- Enemy drone models redesigned, making all the flying enemies much more distinct and appealing to grind through,
- Due to a common request, we added free movement mode that can be used instead of teleportation,
- 2 new maps added, most of the maps got updated and refreshed,
- New campaign structure that improves the gameplay tempo, making it more dynamic and exciting to progress through: the level change is now forced, with new content and challenges adding on every next map,
- New crazy powerup: Madness Mode that lets you shoot two death metal miniguns for some time. Like literally, you are killing enemies with guns that play heavy music while shooting.



We are eager to hear what you think about the new experience we’ve prepared for you. Can’t wait to improve it to make it even better!

Cheers,
Hyperbook Studio team

notes.title: Regenesis Arcade full release
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31209455/6859440a8fa956c943a50e734ed4e2678587d8b4.jpg

Most important numbers regarding Regenesis Arcade:

-September 7th, 2018- the brand new Regenesis Arcade comes out

-$7.99- the permanent price reduction

-13 weapons- bringing diversity to weapons, including some sweet heavy weapons!

-8 maps: brand new ones and old ones, redesigned for the most stunning experience

-2 locomotion modes: teleport and free movement

More perks and redesigned gameplay.

Join us on our mission to save Earth, and we will see you at the top of the high scores, soon!

notes.title: ROAD TO FULL RELEASE: Regenesis Arcade
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31209455/b9f30748c41e7a5763d2d7e8af130e3732cca3a3.jpg

Hello everybody!

It's been a while since we did patches and updates on the state of Regenesis Arcade development. The reason we've been AFK for a while is that we are currently working on polishing, expanding, and delivering Regenesis Arcade, that now started to feel like a totally different game.

We are bringing more content, updates to maps, deeper gameplay, and overall feel, that will soon be available for beta testing, with full release scheduled for September 7th, 2018!

So stay tuned, follow us on Steam, and get ready for playing the totally new, totally awesome Regenesis Arcade in full effect!

Cheers!

notes.title: Leaderboard Update: You did it!
notes.notes:
Hey,

We looked onto the leaderboards and we are shocked to see that you smashed all our Hyperbook scores. Looks like we have to spend some more time fighting drones to be able to compete with you guys!

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31209455/4c4b04671820bc6f65c29630397f558cfea0b102.jpg

Also this extremely long nick on the first place caused the bug with name overlapping the score. GOOD JOB, now that's one more fix we have to make.

We also released few minor silent updates that should fix some optimization issues and added a slight rebalance. It's also much easier to switch weapon now behind your head, as you don't have to reach so far behind.

But, anyway, get ready for revenge next time, as we will dominate the scores again! Argh!

Maciej Karbownik
Designer/Programmer
Hyperbook Studio

notes.title: New year, new update
notes.notes:
Hey, guys!

All the dust has settled down and looks like you all like the game. Don't be shy then, feel free to post a comment and a review on the store page, it will help us a lot! On the other hand, if you found any bugs or issues, make sure to post it on the forums.

With this update come several fixes and changes:

FEATURE: we added special spawner in front of player starting location that will spawn powerup, barrel or exploding barrel on beginning of every wave.
CRITICAL FIX: different boss types will now appear properly, as most of the time it was the same guy over and over.
MINOR FIXES:
- double damage works now properly with railgun,
- Piercing Shots perk will actually pierce targets now,
- level music will now properly reset after the boss fight,
- drones will not crash into one another so often,
- rebalanced point systems.

Happy new year!

notes.title: Release day - IT'S ALIVE!
notes.notes:
The day has come!

Today we launch the full version of our debut title, Regenesis Arcade Deluxe!

Early Access allows us to get the crucial feedback earlier than during the traditional release. It means that the game can be still a bit rough around the edges. We count on your reports, ideas and positive attitude. We can make it together to the final release!

We are proud of what we've achieved and extremely happy to share it with you today. It was a long way to get there, we grew in size as a team and earned tons of experience. It wasn't easy to press the "Release" button but the time has come to show our effort to the public.

Be gentle with it!

Just joking, report us every bug or issue you may encounter so we can fix it. We didn't plan to sleep anyway, you know.

Have fun and happy drone hunting!

Hyperbook Studio
